title: Amazon CloudFront to AWS Lambda URLs
description: Front AWS Lambda Function URLs with Amazon CloudFront

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An Amazon CloudFront distribution is created that forwards requests to the domain name of the deployed AWS Lambda function URL.
Amazon CloudFront also allows for custom domain names, AWS Web Application Firewall (WAF) and AWS Shield Advanced to protect your endpoint from attacks.
